<MethodEndpoint
  method={'patch'}
  path={'/v1/admin/encryption/rotation'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

Stores the automatic-rotation schedule on the active key, or clears it with `null`. The next rotation is always the active key's creation plus this interval, never this request's own instant, so choosing an interval shorter than the active key's age makes it due immediately and the engine rotates on its next check (`ENCRYPTION_KEY_ROTATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`). A rotation — scheduled or asked for with `POST /keys` — creates a key that carries the same schedule forward and restarts the countdown from its own creation. Turning encryption on schedules no rotation at all. Idempotent: choosing the interval already in force changes nothing. Returns the resulting state, as `GET` would.
